title: Order Status Card
description: Displays an order's status, storefront, total, order time, and expected delivery, with a link to the order record.

name.title: Order Name
name.description: Order name or number shown in the card heading.

status.title: Status
status.description: Order status label (e.g. Draft, Confirmed, Processed, Out for Delivery, Delivered, Canceled).

storefrontName.title: Storefront
storefrontName.description: Name of the storefront that received the order.

totalAmount.title: Total Amount
totalAmount.description: Order total in the order's currency.

deliveryTime.title: Expected Delivery
deliveryTime.description: Expected delivery time; blank when not yet scheduled.

orderRecordLink.title: Order Record Link
orderRecordLink.description: Absolute URL to the order record's detail page, used by the View Order button.
